nodes.label: OASIS CALS Table Adapter
nodes.rationale: Translates CALS namest/nameend/morerows into colspan/rowspan while preserving colspec metadata.

nodes.label: @dita/core Shared Kernel
nodes.rationale: Centralizes DITA lexical/AST models, lossless XML round-trip, and baseline semantic rules across frontend and backend.

nodes.label: Visual-Source Dual-Mode State Machine
nodes.rationale: Blocks Source to Visual transitions on malformed XML to prevent corrupting the ProseMirror tree.

nodes.label: Unknown Element Passthrough Nodes
nodes.rationale: Maps unmodeled or specialized DITA elements to unknown_block and unknown_inline with rawAttrs to preserve fidelity without full schema modeling.

nodes.label: Persistent Java Worker (Xerces2 + Jing + DITA-OT)
nodes.rationale: Avoids 1-2s JVM cold start per validation by caching DITA 1.3 grammar pools and running async DITA-OT HTML5/PDF builds with Noto CJK fonts.

nodes.label: Root Map Semantic Engine
nodes.rationale: Incremental per-branch indexer resolving keydef/keyref, conref/conkeyref with DFS cycle detection, and DITAVAL profiling.

nodes.label: Check-out Exclusive Lock & Branch Worktree
nodes.rationale: Uses PostgreSQL unique constraints and branch-isolated git worktrees instead of CRDT real-time collaboration.

nodes.label: Lossless XML Round-trip
nodes.rationale: Standard DITA XML is the single source of truth; preserving DOCTYPE, comments, PIs, CDATA, and attribute order prevents Git diff noise.
